title: Teacher Studio game spec (input of scripts/build.py)

use.description: class = big board-readable type + teacher defaults; personal = normal type floor, same tools

rounds.description: use only the first N (shuffled) items

shuffleChoices.description: spread correct answers over A-D (quiz, escape, board)

bonusEvery.description: quiz: every Nth question is worth double (0 = off)

penalty.description: escape: seconds lost per wrong answer (default 10)

maxTurns.description: board: turns per team before the game ends (default 8)

subject.description: 과학 | 수학 | 국어 | 영어 | 사회 | 역사 | 도덕 | 가족 ...

mood.description: 긴장감 | 신남 | 차분 | 따뜻함 | 밝음 | 자연 ...

seed.description: change to get another look from the same words

large.description: personal use only: class-size type (grandparents, far screens)

world.description: optional texts: qLabel, lockName, goodText, speak (bingo read-aloud), lang

items.description: quiz/escape/board: {q, choices[2-4], answer, exp?, clue?} or {type:'ox', q, answer:0|1}; survival: OX only; match: {a,b}; bingo: {word,clue,say?}; sort: {q,a,exp?}
